Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                               ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing PD 579
symbols and indications as shown on Map 2-F in the area bounded by:

        West Van Buren Street; South Franklin Street; West Congress Parkway; and South Wacker Drive

to those of the DC-16 Downtown Core District.

       SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication




Address:            401 S. Wacker Drive / 300 W. Van Buren, Chicago, Illinois
